  colorMode: mono,

      separation: 4.3,
      alignment: 1.5,
      cohesion: 1.4,

      separationRadius: 62,

      maxForce: 1,

    aberration: 18.4

    tex: read(o0),
    focalDistance: 15.35,

    sampleBias: 33.51
  )

  .grain(alpha: 0.18)

      redDelay: 4,
      greenDelay: 2,
      blueDelay: 0
    )
    .bloom(taps: 15)

render(o1)
